item.title: Makary Resigns, Biogen Alzheimer's Data
item.description:
• Summary: This article covers two major stories: the resignation of Makary (likely a health official) and Biogen's release of new Alzheimer's disease clinical data. The Alzheimer's data could have significant implications for the neurology treatment landscape and patient care.
